# Build plan: the single-file site

**Output.** `siding/brand-v2/site.html`, generated by `siding/brand-v2/build/build_site.py`.

**Inputs.**
- Tokens: `phase2/tokens.css`.
- Mark: `marks.c1`.
- Icons: `phase2/icons.py`.
- Proven mechanisms: `phase3/build_phase3b.py`.
- Page plan: `phase3/build_phase3a.py` → `PAGES`.

## Rules (addendum + brief)

- One HTML file holds all six pages. In-file navigation uses hash routes `#/`, `#/siding`, `#/windows`, `#/roofing`, `#/work`, `#/about`.
- **Exactly two versions per section**, built one section and one version at a time. Each section shows a small version switch (review chrome; hidden with `?clean`).
- **Superseded versions** go to hidden in-file backups as `<template class="bk" data-sec data-v data-rev>`. They are never deleted.
- **Before each section:** study its annex reference: live frames plus code-level notes, logged in IMAGE-REGISTRY §6 and later sections.
- **After each section:** an audit-improve cycle covering 1440 and 375, keyboard, reduced motion, contrast, and the facts grep. Commit.
- Facts: the lock only. Captions give the place (and trade) only. Forms never claim sent or saved.
- **Images, each embedded once:**
  - The first use has a real `src`.
  - Later uses carry `data-img` and are filled by JS from that first element's `src`.
  - Without JS, every page is shown stacked and the first uses still render.
- **One scroll engine:** a single rAF-throttled native scroll listener drives every pinned section through a registry of `{el, onProgress}`.

## Homepage, the two versions per section

| # | Section | V1 | V2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Hero (MERSI) | Before/after split of one job, process plate (proof P1) | After photo beside the B3 section drawing of the same wall; the plate steps through the process |
| 2 | Proof band (Dropbox) | One line of locked proof beside the primary action | Four cells, each with an icon; the course line beneath |
| 3 | Record numeral (Apple) | Pinned: dots fill, 312 revealed by clip, never counted | Big numeral on the left, static map on the right, the locked sentence revealed line by line |
| 4 | Services router (Lusion) | Three cards (Phase 2 exemplar) | Three full-width rows; large type; the photo reveals on hover or focus |
| 5 | Wall assembly (Lusion · Graza) | Pinned scroll build (proof P3) | Four tabs: an exploded view that steps through layers on click |
| 6 | Colour as content (Cash App) | Six vertical full-bleed steel fields | Horizontal bands laid as courses, one value per course |
| 7 | Visualiser entry (Quiet Cubes · Rimowa) | Configurator-first gate: four profile tiles | A 4-step strip with a live mini preview |
| 8 | Map preview (Bruno, static) | Static dot field + the locked line + a link | Split: three job photos beside a mini map |
| 9 | Before/after seam (MERSI) | Seam with pair chips (proof P2) | A full-bleed seam with the pair list as a vertical index on the left |
| 10 | Since 2009 (Scout) | Horizontal film roll: 2009 · 2018 · today | Vertical timeline on the course-line spine |
| 11 | Close (Dropbox) | Subtraction: one line, hours, two actions | B4 evening field, phone at display size |

The inner pages follow `PAGES` in `build_phase3a.py`. Their version pairs are written before each page is started.
